questions.question: Explain the difference between a kilowatt and a kilowatt-hour.
questions.expected_answer: A kilowatt is a unit of power, the rate at which energy is transferred (1 kW = 1 000 J each second); a kilowatt-hour is a unit of energy, the energy used by a 1 kW appliance in one hour (3 600 000 J). Electricity is sold in kilowatt-hours.

questions.question: A 1 800 W iron is used for 40 minutes. Calculate the cost at R2,50 per kWh.
A family loads R300 of prepaid electricity at R2,50 per kWh. Their geyser uses 9 kWh a day. How many days would the units last for the geyser alone?
questions.expected_answer: Units bought = 300 ÷ 2,50 = 120 kWh; days = 120 ÷ 9 ≈ 13,3, so about 13 days.
